name: Stand & breathe + shoulder rolls
cue: Stand up. Inhale, lift shoulders toward your ears; exhale and drop them fully. Repeat.

name: Standing forward fold
cue: Soft knees. Hinge at the hips and hang the upper body down. Relax head and neck; feel the hamstrings and low back lengthen.

name: Standing figure-4 (left)
cue: Hold a chair. Cross left ankle over right knee, sit the hips back. Feel a stretch deep in the left glute.

name: Standing figure-4 (right)
cue: Switch sides. Right ankle over left knee, hips back, keep the spine long — no rounding.

name: Hip-flexor lunge stretch (left)
cue: Big step forward with the left foot into a lunge, back heel lifted, tuck the pelvis slightly. Feel the front of the right hip open.

name: Hip-flexor lunge stretch (right)
cue: Switch sides. Stay tall through the torso, no shrugging, slow your breathing.

name: Standing spinal rotation
cue: Feet hip-width, arms crossed over the chest. Slowly rotate the torso left and right, letting the eyes follow.

name: Neck side stretch
cue: Rest your right hand gently on the left side of the head, ease the head toward the right shoulder, left shoulder down. Switch sides, then return to your desk.
